note: Each shop's point for the demand-signal NWS collector (item 4), stored as a catering_fulfillment_nodes row with offers_delivery = false and offers_pickup = false so the customer order funnel does not change. Tenant DATA: written by scripts/seed-shop-points.ts (dry run by default; CC runs --apply, sim first, then prod), never by a migration. A shop is matched by name against ACTIVE locations (case-insensitive, exactly one match). A shop that already has a node is never touched: catering owns that row.
